allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Force | Select-Object Mode, Name; Write-Output "---"; Write-Output "Node: $\(node -v 2>$null\)"; Write-Output "npm: $\(npm -v 2>$null\)"; Write-Output "git: $\(git --version 2>$null\)"; Write-Output "docker: $\(docker --version 2>$null\)"; Write-Output "ffmpeg: $\(\(Get-Command ffmpeg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source\)")
PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Force | Select-Object Mode, Length, Name; Write-Output "---"; \(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object\).Count)

PowerShell(function v\($n,$c\){ try { "$n = " + \(& $c 2>$null\) } catch { "$n = MISSING" } }; v "node" { node -v }; v "pnpm" { pnpm -v }; v "npm" { npm -v }; v "docker" { docker -v }; v "ffmpeg" { \(ffmpeg -version | Select-Object -First 1\) }; v "git" { git --version })
